description: Publish the included website's working HTTP application at its generated HTTPS hostname or one exact custom hostname the owner has verified with verify_domain. Point the custom hostname at the generated free-<operation ID without hyphens>.redu.cloud name using CNAME (or the same public edge address for an apex). Only one hostname is served: a custom hostname replaces the generated hostname, not an additional alias. Omit domain to keep the current hostname; pass null to restore the generated one. Verify application readiness and authentication first. All public website HTTP/HTTPS response bodies share 5 GB per UTC month, including multiple routes. Incoming uploads, VM downloads, SSH and private SQL are excluded. No direct public IP is assigned. Database publication and WebSocket upgrades are unavailable. Give the returned URL only after the action completes.

request_key.description: Stable request key. Reuse it after a timeout; never repeat an unknown command with a new key.

name: publish_free_website
